endpoints.name: Transport machinery
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding the Lsr ATP-binding and permease transport machinery
endpoints.boundary: Does not establish AI-2 binding, intracellular phosphorylation, LsrR-mediated regulation or activity.

endpoints.name: Binding plus transport
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding the LsrABCD binding-and-transport module
endpoints.boundary: Does not establish intracellular phosphorylation, LsrR-mediated regulation or activity.

endpoints.name: Uptake and intracellular processing
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding Lsr-mediated AI-2 binding, uptake and phosphorylation potential
endpoints.boundary: Not a full local Lsr component-set call; does not establish LsrR-mediated response or activity.

endpoints.name: Full local component set
endpoints.wording: Genome containing the full local LsrA/B/C/D/K/R component set
endpoints.boundary: Sequence evidence does not establish expression, uptake, phosphorylation or regulatory activity.

endpoints.name: AI-2-binding substep
endpoints.boundary: Does not establish membrane transduction or complete AI-2 reception.

endpoints.name: Membrane-transduction substep
endpoints.boundary: Does not establish LuxP-dependent ligand binding or AI-2-specific reception.

endpoints.name: Complete LuxPQ-mediated AI-2 reception
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding the LuxP-LuxQ binding-and-transduction pair
endpoints.boundary: Sequence evidence does not establish expression, ligand availability or receptor activity.

endpoints.name: DSF sensing and initial transduction
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding RpfC-mediated DSF sensing and initial transduction potential
endpoints.boundary: Downstream RpfG-mediated response, ligand specificity and activity remain unresolved.

endpoints.name: Canonical receptor-response context
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding the RpfC-RpfG receptor-and-response context
endpoints.boundary: Does not establish ligand specificity, pathway activity or phenotype; RpfG alone is not DSF reception.

endpoints.name: HHQ-core biosynthetic potential
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding the PqsABCD HHQ-forming core
endpoints.boundary: Does not establish PQS conversion, full regulatory output or product formation; PqsE contribution is strain-dependent.

endpoints.name: PQS-conversion potential
endpoints.wording: Candidate encoding the PqsABCD HHQ core plus PqsH-mediated PQS-conversion potential
endpoints.boundary: Requires suitable oxygen and substrate conditions; does not establish product formation or full regulatory output.
